name: Baizhi Cloud Browser
tagline: On-demand cloud browser sessions for coding agents.
description: Baizhi Cloud Browser (CapyBrowser) provides on-demand cloud browser sessions for coding agents. This MCP connection manages sessions and CDP access; a compatible CDP client performs page actions. Sessions may incur charges: check current prices, explicitly stop sessions you create, and check resource release and billing afterward. Disconnecting a client does not end the remote session.

install.notes: Replace <API_KEY> in Cline's private MCP settings before connecting. The setup guide explains CDP page clients and session cleanup.
